title: Quantum Entanglement in the Dirac Field Quantization around Charged Black Holes
summary: We investigate the quantum entanglement properties of the Dirac field near a charged Reissner--Nordström black hole, incorporating the effects of Hawking radiation within the framework of quantum field theory in curved spacetime. Using concurrence \( C \) and Bures distance \( B \) as measures of entanglement, we analyze how quantum correlations evolve with respect to the electric charge \( Q \) of the black hole, the frequency \( ω\) of fermionic modes, and the initial entanglement angle \( θ\). Our results show that the electric charge \( Q \) enhances decoherence inside the event horizon…
